metric_definitions.label: Intake assessment completed
metric_definitions.definition: Share of new patients with PHQ-9, GAD-7 and a suicide-risk screen completed at the first visit.
metric_definitions.numerator: New patients with PHQ-9 + GAD-7 + risk screen on the intake date
metric_definitions.denominator: Patients with an intake in the last 6 months (intake 14+ days ago)

metric_definitions.label: Care plan by session 2
metric_definitions.definition: Share of new patients with a documented care plan by their second attended session.
metric_definitions.numerator: New patients with a care plan dated on or before session 2
metric_definitions.denominator: Patients with an intake in the last 6 months who have attended 2+ sessions

metric_definitions.label: Geriatric screen at intake
metric_definitions.definition: Share of new patients with both a GDS-15 (late-life depression) and a Mini-Cog (cognitive screen) by session 2.
metric_definitions.numerator: New patients with GDS-15 and Mini-Cog on or before session 2
metric_definitions.denominator: Patients with an intake in the last 6 months who have attended 2+ sessions

metric_definitions.label: Outcome re-measured in last 60 days
metric_definitions.definition: Share of active patients (in care 60+ days) with a PHQ-9 in the last 60 days.
metric_definitions.numerator: Active patients with a PHQ-9 in the last 60 days
metric_definitions.denominator: Active patients whose intake was 60+ days ago

metric_definitions.label: Improved since intake
metric_definitions.definition: Share of patients who started at PHQ-9 ≥ 10 whose latest PHQ-9 is 5+ points lower than intake (the minimal clinically important difference).
metric_definitions.numerator: Patients whose latest PHQ-9 is ≥ 5 points below intake
metric_definitions.denominator: Patients seen in last 12 months with intake PHQ-9 ≥ 10 and a follow-up PHQ-9 6+ weeks after intake

metric_definitions.label: Remission at 6 months
metric_definitions.definition: Share of patients who started at PHQ-9 ≥ 10 with a PHQ-9 < 5 at 6 months (most recent score 4-8 months after intake). No score in the window counts as not in remission, as in the CMS measure.
metric_definitions.numerator: Patients with PHQ-9 < 5 at the 6-month point
metric_definitions.denominator: Patients with intake PHQ-9 ≥ 10 whose 6-month window has closed (intake 8-14 months ago)

metric_definitions.label: Same-day safety plan after positive risk screen
metric_definitions.definition: Share of positive suicide-risk screens followed by a safety plan or escalation the same day.
metric_definitions.numerator: Positive screens with a safety plan / escalation on the same day
metric_definitions.denominator: Positive risk screens in the last 12 months

metric_definitions.label: PCP referral within 7 days
metric_definitions.definition: Share of physical health concerns raised in therapy that were referred to the patient's primary care provider within 7 days.
metric_definitions.numerator: Concerns referred to PCP within 7 days
metric_definitions.denominator: Physical health concerns identified in the last 12 months (7+ days ago)

metric_definitions.label: Early dropout
metric_definitions.definition: Share of new patients who attended 2 or fewer sessions and then stopped coming (no visit in 30+ days, not a planned discharge).
metric_definitions.numerator: New patients with ≤ 2 attended sessions and no visit in 30+ days
metric_definitions.denominator: Patients with an intake in the last 12 months (intake 45+ days ago)

metric_definitions.label: Provider late cancels / no-shows
metric_definitions.definition: Share of scheduled sessions the therapist cancelled late (<24h) or missed.

metric_definitions.label: Provider reschedules
metric_definitions.definition: Share of scheduled sessions the therapist moved to another time.

metric_definitions.label: Available hours / week
metric_definitions.definition: Hours the therapist opens for booking each week, as a share of the clinical hours they committed to.
metric_definitions.numerator: Hours open for booking this week

metric_definitions.label: Notes signed within 48 hours
metric_definitions.definition: Share of attended sessions with the progress note signed within 48 hours.
metric_definitions.denominator: Attended sessions, last 90 days (2+ days ago)

metric_definitions.label: Claims accepted first pass
metric_definitions.definition: Share of claims accepted by the payer on first submission (no denial or rework).

rules.trigger: Positive suicide-risk screen with no safety plan documented the same day
rules.action: Same-day check-in with the patient; complete and document a safety plan

rules.trigger: Elder abuse / neglect concern with no safety assessment or APS report by the next day
rules.action: Confirm safety; document assessment; report to Adult Protective Services where required

rules.trigger: Fall, confusion or medication reaction not sent to the PCP after 1 day; any other physical health concern after 7 days
Notes signed within 48h < 90% or claims accepted first pass < 90% (trailing 4 weeks)
rules.action: Connect with the provider this week to get back on track

rules.trigger: Hours offered for next week below contracted hours; or 2+ provider late cancels / no-shows in the last week, or > 6% over the last 4 weeks
rules.action: Connect with the provider this week to get back on track

rules.trigger: Newly flagged since last Monday: PHQ-9 up 5+ points into the 10+ range; not improving after 12+ weeks; safety plan completed late; disengaged 30+ days; PHQ-9 overdue; intake incomplete. Ongoing items stay on each therapist's page for 1:1s.
A scorecard KPI newly fell past its flag line over the prior 2 weeks
A target newly met and held for 2 weeks (KPI or overall rating); patients newly in remission

global_rules: Bundled across the whole pod: one full-state digest every Monday, plus a daily list for urgent escalations only.
Every open item shows how many days it has been open. Urgent items open more than 48 hours escalate to the clinical director.
Each item has an owner, so the lead only acts on what needs the lead.
The lead closes each item with a short outcome note, which builds an audit trail.
New hires (first 90 days) get no provider performance alerts; patient-safety alerts always fire.
Hospital and ED discharges are not alerted on: Sailor has no reliable discharge signal today. First addition once an ADT feed is in place.
